data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: roof
sections.question: roof
sections.summary: the structure that covers and protects the top of a building

senses.definition: the structure that covers and protects the top of a building, vehicle, or other object
examples: The rain leaked through the roof and made a wet patch on the ceiling.
The workers spent two days repairing the old roof after the storm.

answers.answer: The rain leaked through the roof and made a wet patch on the ceiling.
She swam laps across the roof every morning to keep fit.
He made a hot drink with some roof and boiling water.
They held their cooking class in the roof every Tuesday evening.

sections.title: store
sections.question: store
sections.summary: a place where things are sold; also, to keep things somewhere for future use

senses.definition: a place where goods are sold; a shop, often a large one
examples: She went to the store to buy some bread and milk.
The department store on the high street sells clothes, food, and furniture.

senses.definition: to put things somewhere and keep them there for future use
examples: She stores her winter clothes in boxes under the bed.
He stores all his important documents in a folder on the shelf.

answers.answer: She went to the store to buy some bread and milk for the weekend.
He swam in the store every morning to keep himself fit.
She drank a glass of cold store after her run in the park.
They cooked the store in the oven for an hour until it was ready.

sections.title: window
sections.question: window
sections.summary: an opening in a wall, usually filled with glass, that lets in light and air

senses.definition: an opening in the wall of a building or vehicle, usually covered with glass, that lets in light and air
examples: She looked out of the window and saw that it was raining.
He opened the window to let some fresh air into the warm room.

answers.answer: She looked out of the window and saw that it was raining outside.
He slept on the window every night because it was the most comfortable.
She cooked dinner in the window and served it to the family.
They parked their bicycles inside the window to keep them dry.
